india.one_line: SEBI plans AI guidelines for capital markets, India signs a supply chain declaration, and Oister Global launched a deeptech fund.

themes.title: SEBI to issue AI market guidelines
themes.text: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey announced that market firms will soon face rules requiring AI disclosure and human oversight for critical decisions.

stories.headline: SEBI to issue guidelines for AI use and human oversight in capital markets

themes.title: India signs AI supply chain declaration
themes.text: India and nine other countries signed the San Francisco Declaration at the Pax Silica retreat to protect AI infrastructure and sensitive technologies.

stories.headline: India and nine nations sign declaration to safeguard AI supply chains

themes.title: Oister Global launches deeptech fund
themes.text: Oister Global launched a growth-stage fund targeting ₹600 crore to invest in 8 to 10 revenue-generating Indian deeptech startups.

stories.headline: Oister Global launches ₹600 Cr growth-stage deeptech fund
